subject: Spot rates for June ocean freight
snippet: This week in ocean freight: Asia-Europe spot rates continued their upward trend, with SCFI Shanghai-Rotterdam climbing 8% to $2,450/TEU. Port congestion at Singapore improved slightl
body: This week in ocean freight: Asia-Europe spot rates continued their upward trend, with SCFI Shanghai-Rotterdam climbing 8% to $2,450/TEU. Port congestion at Singapore improved slightly with average dwell times dropping to 3.2 days. Meanwhile, the IMO's updated carbon intensity regulations take effect July 1 — carriers are expected to slow-steam more aggressively on transpacific lanes, which could add 2-3 days to transit times. Blank sailings on the Asia-USWC trade remain elevated at 12% of capacity through mid-July. Download our full weekly rate report at freightmarket.test/reports.
